notes.title: Steam Next Fest and Dev Update
notes.notes:
Hi all! 

Steam Next Fest is coming soon and Drunkard Simulator is opted in! 

That means a demo is on the way, so get ready.



The demo will be a limited version of the full game (since the full thing isn’t quite ready yet). Some features and quests won’t be included, but don’t worry, there will be plenty of chances to forget your pants and get wonderfully chaotic in Drunkard Simulator.



What’s been going on lately? 
We’ve been focused on preparing the demo with more features and improvements:

Crafting system: Brew your own cider, kilju, and wine... flavored with whatever you can toss into the bucket.

More loot & exploration: Extra things to find, steal, or stumble upon.

Cars: Now you can load your treasures, junk, or “found” items straight into the car.

Character customization: Expanded wardrobe with more clothes to dress your drunken self.

Overall improvements: Tweaks and polish across the board.

Storyline & guests: Expanding the world with more characters and silly situations.



And psst... there might be a second limited playtest happening in our Discord. If you want to be useful (and have fun at the same time), you might want to join.

notes.title: Drunkard Simulator Dev Update: First quests, drunken parkour physics and cars!
notes.notes:
Hi all!


I hope you’re having a great summer so far. Here in Finland the summer hasn’t really started yet but there’s still time! Here’s something I have been brewing up for you in the meantime:


First quest


First two quests have been implemented. They are quick tutorials which walks you through the basic game mechanics like drinking, cooking, managing your inventory, buying stuff and returning bottles of course!

All quests in the game can be done alone or in multiplayer co-op. Progress and inventory will travel with the player character from session to session.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470730/9d065ad6e41724f7574688a4cf4bb4dc53a11c4c.png"]
[previewyoutube="Wfi82OeUGBk;full"][/previewyoutube]

Drunken Parkour Physics


As you get more drunk in the game the probability to fall increases. Any step up or curb may end up lethal. Climbing will also become more difficult on higher drunkenness levels. Too bad some places require you to be wasted to get into while also being fenced or higher than ground level.


[previewyoutube="N6Z_Fs7Nm8U;full"][/previewyoutube]



Cars with stereos!


I’ve added new cars to the game and implemented a stereo with tuneable EQ. It's a prototype but it works. With that you can achieve an authentic subwoofer only car audio experience.


Cars can now run out of fuel so be aware of that when heading out of town. Oh, they can also blow up so be careful.


[previewyoutube="vjrw5jhD3PI;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Drunkard Simulator Dev Update: Store, Map & Optimizations
notes.notes:
Store

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470730/8de04dc3c99187b06f5bf1e2c2b311a5f0e5b7c0.png

[previewyoutube=2v2PDKyuLYA;full][/previewyoutube]


 Put items into a cart and use self-checkout to buy items. 
 Shelves are refilled daily. 
 If you’re drunk enough you may attempt to steal items but beware of the consequences! 


Landscape (work very much in progress) 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470730/b3d6ab2b4c6afd0f379f37b32e5804a4934b0cd7.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470730/3b7c15e3cd2b195f8bdacce07ec10b90d4195d4e.png


 Many miles of road to explore by car. Beware of driving offroad, it’s a long way home… 
 There’s some points of interest by the road that offer some unique objects to be found. 


Optimizations 


 A lot has already been done but there’s still work to do. 
 We’re aiming 60-100 fps on decent hardware with ray tracing enabled. 
 Every small to medium size object being movable has caused some issues with the game thread but the performance is quite good now.

notes.title: Drunkard Simulator Dev Update: Cooking, Chaos, and Unexpected Flights
notes.notes:
What’s Been Brewing?

🥩 Cooking is functional!

Players can now cook (and yes, burn) food in Drunkard Simulator.

The oven and stove are now fully functional, and you can adjust the stove’s heat levels to perfectly cook—or completely ruin—your meal! 

[previewyoutube=rXbW7-YJG3c;full][/previewyoutube]

🎮 More Interactive Objects!

We’ve expanded the list of objects you can mess around with. 

This also led to some... unexpected discoveries. Like, say, using a mat to fly. Totally intentional, right?

The inventory is also ready!

[previewyoutube=TNYGZASU6gY;full][/previewyoutube]

📜 The Main Menu is Taking Shape!

Soon, you’ll be able to admire a properly functional main menu before stumbling into the game.

🧍 NPCs Are Getting Smarter (or Dumber?)

We’re working on NPCs, making sure they react appropriately—or inappropriately—to the world around them.

notes.title: Drunkard Simulator Dev Update: Progress, Features & What’s Next!
notes.notes:
Hello, traveler! 🍻

What’s Been Done So Far? A lot.

The Map:
Your drunken playground is a cozy neighborhood, with plenty of small details still to be added (or stolen). Like rubber ducks—can you find them all? 🦆

A bar and a store are still missing—essential stops to keep your booze supply steady. Plans are also in place for a thrift store (where you can sell “found” items from the curb) and a grill (because every drunkard needs a snack).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470730/3bdd10f01638b4b1096a8ee420f0a5aec7d50191.png

Stats:
A HUD tracks hunger, energy, and your drunkenness level (BAC). Some tweaking is still needed, but the essentials are in place.

Drunken Animations:
Animations capture the perfect stumbling experience, with more improvements on the way. Soon, walking in a straight line will be just as hard as in real life after a few too many. Naturally, ragdoll physics and slapstick moments are included.

[previewyoutube=tkrHd7DuwTM;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=EfXasuhP3DE;full][/previewyoutube]

Object Interaction:
Pick up whatever you like—what you do with it is entirely up to you.

Steal from the neighbors? Go ahead.
Rearrange furniture like an intoxicated interior designer? Sounds like a plan.
Fill your inventory with rubber ducks and garden gnomes? That’s an option too. (Seriously, what’s up with all the rubber ducks?)
[previewyoutube=I5e7OuB8UqM;full][/previewyoutube]


NPCs:
The neighborhood isn’t empty! NPCs roam the area, though they don’t serve much purpose yet.

Emotes & Interactions:
Basic emotes are in, but interactions with NPCs are still in the works.

What’s Next? A lot.

-A proper main menu
-Endless tweaks and improvements
-More rubber ducks
-And of course, booze. Lots of booze.
-Oh, and those drunken tasks waiting for you to stumble upon.
-Aaaaand everything else.
